items.headline: $AERO Launches as Aerodrome & Velodrome Merge Across 7 Chains
items.summary: Aerodrome and Velodrome merged into $AERO, now live on Ethereum, Base, Robinhood Chain, Ink, OP Mainnet, Arc and Arbitrum — a mega-DEX play.

items.headline: $SWELL Rates Manipulated After Railway Key-Drain Warning
items.summary: Researchers flagged inflated swETH and rswETH rates on $SWELL following a cloud-platform key exposure; 2,513 ETH flagged but loss unconfirmed.

items.headline: $HYPE Vault Unlocks Early Access to New Domain Names
items.summary: D3's new Upshift-built $HYPE vault earns Frontier Points for priority domain registration, with Hyperion DeFi as launch partner.

items.headline: $UNI Aggregator Hooks Go Live on Ethereum, Base & Robinhood
items.summary: Uniswap Labs launched aggregator hooks letting $UNI v4 route trades through liquidity on external platforms across three chains.

items.headline: $STRK Vote Backs Post-Quantum Layer 1 With 93.5% Support
items.summary: Starknet's community overwhelmingly backed research into an independent post-quantum L1; a draft whitepaper is expected in November.
